common.composition: Mechanism-first, high-information-density technical diagram with a coherent directional flow, clear visual hierarchy, fine-grained explanatory structure, generous safe margins, and a composition visibly distinct from the other five stories.
restrictions: no people, faces, humanoid figures, hands, or character silhouettes
no photos or decorative object imagery
no product-screen imitation, dashboard screenshot, chat UI, or generic status architecture
no decorative filler, stock icons, or ornamental backgrounds
no unsupported metrics, claims, or invented product capabilities
no overlapping, clipped, tiny, or illegible text
visible text must be limited to the story-specific allowed_text list; omit uncertain text rather than improvise
no SVG, placeholder, collage, or reused composition
use abstract technical layers, rails, graphs, nodes, evidence paths, and connectors to explain the mechanism
common.visible_text_guard: Only exact strings in allowed_text may appear. Spell them exactly. Do not invent captions, legends, acronyms, numbers, labels, or filler text.

specs.subject: NVIDIA DOCA Agent Skills: verified domain knowledge packaged for infrastructure development
specs.mechanism: Center a maintained DOCA Skill package containing machine-readable skill guidance. Feed an application task into the package, then fan through four verification rails—API signatures, hardware requirements, build constraints, and preflight checks—before the agent can produce a BlueField application path. Show the verification rails converging into an evidence-backed output and a validation return loop so the image explains why reusable skill knowledge is safer and more repeatable than ad-hoc prompting.
visual_structure: left intake rail for application task
right-side application output and validation loop

specs.subject: Qodo 3.0: code-quality controls embedded in agentic software delivery
specs.mechanism: Show a proposed code change entering a multi-stage verification pipeline. A Software Map supplies cross-repository context and blast-radius relationships; PR Triage decomposes the review into work packages; Standards and Agentic review apply explicit quality checks; evidence then routes the change toward Accept or Repair. Make the dependency graph and feedback path visually prominent so the reader can see how context and review controls constrain agent-written software.
visual_structure: upper context graph showing repository relationships
right evidence decision with repair loop

specs.subject: Google Workspace: AI actions grounded across everyday work context
specs.mechanism: Create an abstract workspace context fabric rather than a product UI. Show Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Chat as separate context streams entering a Gemini context-and-action layer. From that layer, branch to an interactive Sheets work surface, object-level image editing, and document-to-video explanation. Use cross-source connectors to show that the mechanism is bringing AI into existing work artifacts while preserving distinct source boundaries.
visual_structure: four source streams on the left
thin provenance lines back to sources

specs.subject: Barclays and Claude: governed AI across knowledge support and high-volume operations
specs.mechanism: Use two parallel regulated-enterprise lanes. The upper lane moves governed enterprise knowledge through retrieval into a RAG assistant and search response. The lower lane moves an email stream through Classify, Enrich, and Route stages. Wrap both lanes in a continuous Governance rail with Human oversight checkpoints and traceable evidence paths, emphasizing controlled reuse of AI across different operational workloads without depicting a bank dashboard.

specs.subject: Databricks agentic marketing: governed next-best actions from customer and business context
specs.mechanism: Merge three distinct input bands—Customer context, Business context, and Decision context—into an agentic decision core. Before any recommendation leaves the core, pass it through Intent, Guardrails, and Approval controls. Route the approved recommendation to a Next-best action, then return measured Outcome feedback into the decision core. The feedback loop should be visually explicit and separate from the governance gates.
visual_structure: three context bands feeding one decision core

specs.subject: Asana Client Management: AI teammates coordinating through shared client context
specs.mechanism: Place a Shared Work Graph at the center as the common source of client, project, ownership, and status context. Arrange four differentiated AI Teammate roles around it—Creative Producer, Account Advisor, Operations Coordinator, and Executive Advisor—with distinct bidirectional flows. Route their outputs into Draft work, Handoffs, Risk, and Portfolio signals, making the shared-context dependency clear without imitating Asana UI.
visual_structure: four role modules around the graph
feedback connectors that keep project state synchronized

distinct_primary_mechanisms: software quality and blast-radius verification pipeline
